about: Franchise dictionary shared by the Apple TV app (FranchiseDictionary.swift) and the web tuner (scripts/nostalgex-franchise-builder.js). Every tmdbCollectionIDs entry was verified against the live TMDB API on 2026-10-11 (collection exists and holds the films named in its note). Edit this file only; both engines read it, and scripts/franchise-golden.json pins the grouping both must produce.

fields.canonicalName: Channel-ready display name, upper-cased. Also the stable id: dict:<canonicalName>.
fields.stockChannelID: The channels.json channel this franchise folds into, or null to build a dynamic channel.
fields.tmdbCollectionIDs: TMDB belongs_to_collection ids that roll up into this franchise. Empty for a studio-ruled franchise.
fields.nameMatchTokens: Word-boundary, case-insensitive substrings. Join TV shows, and films TMDB leaves outside any collection.
fields.tvShowTitles: Shows that belong but do not name-match. Exact title, case and punctuation ignored.
fields.filmTitles: Films with no collection on TMDB that do not name-match. Exact title, trailing (YYYY) ignored.
fields.studioRuled: True when the stock channel's studio rule owns the films. Only TV joins, by exact tvShowTitles.
fields.defaultOn: A found dynamic franchise with this flag starts switched on.

franchises.note: 10 = Star Wars Collection, all nine Skywalker-saga films. Rogue One and Solo are belongs_to_collection null on TMDB and join by the star wars token (their titles end in A Star Wars Story).

franchises.note: Studio-ruled: CH101 carries studios: [Marvel Studios]. MCU films scatter across dozens of tiny TMDB collections, so collection grouping is the wrong tool. Shows join by EXACT title only, so Echo cannot pull in Echo Park. List order: Disney+ MCU, Netflix era, ABC era; the Marvel's spellings are how TVDB and older Plex agents title them.
1241 = Harry Potter Collection, 435259 = Fantastic Beasts Collection. Together the Wizarding World, both fold onto CH102.
328 = Jurassic Park Collection, all eight films with Jurassic World included.

franchises.note: Five TMDB collections merged, verified live 2026-10-13 via search/collection: 556 = Spider-Man (Raimi trilogy), 125574 = The Amazing Spider-Man, 531241 = Spider-Man (MCU), 573436 = Spider-Man: Spider-Verse, 225941 = Spider-Man (TV), the 1977-80 TV films. Its own channel, not folded into MARVEL CH101; the MCU films also pass CH101's Marvel Studios rule, and Settings counts them under SPIDER-MAN only. The token joins shows (The Amazing Spider-Man, Spider-Man: The Animated Series).
